title: The staging batch size would not have been safe in production
body: The runbook was about to copy --batch-size 5000 from staging, where the replica has no concurrent readers. Production reads that table on every checkout.

title: The low-traffic window was solving the wrong problem
body: Once the constraint was understood to be lock contention rather than throughput, a 03:00 run bought a smaller team rather than a safer migration.

title: 62% of the duration is the index rebuild, not the writes
body: Measured, not assumed. Raising the batch size barely changes duration and increases lock hold linearly — the intuitive tuning move is the dangerous one.

title: 500 holds, 1000 is already visible to users
body: Verified against mirrored production traffic: 500 moves p99 by 3ms, 1000 by 40ms. The safe margin is narrower than anyone guessed.
